rows.question: When employees are eating cake in a shared space, who must be offered a slice?
rows.answer:
The leader of the other pod must be offered a slice of cake when it is eaten in a shared space. The slice must be at least as large as the slice the offerer keeps. This is stated in the rule: "The leader of the other pod must still be offered a slice of any cake eaten in a shared space.
